lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 5-6 horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the pectoral fin attachment, transitioning into more sparse, single-row alignment towards the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical striae of higher pixel intensity relative to the base skin tone, intersecting with the centroid blobs to form a grid-like topology across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: One primary longitudinal ridge is visible with a high-contrast transition; high-luminance pixels on the dorsal side of the ridge and a shadow-induced low-luminance gradient on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Three to four discrete high-luminance blobs are visible within the dorsal fin silhouette, including one prominent cluster near the posterior margin and several smaller, lower-contrast clusters near the anterior base.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high density of small, high-frequency luminance blobs, significantly smaller in diameter than those on the lateral flank.
